recognize_zh: 抹片中大量中型母細胞，核形不規則、染色質細緻，胞質灰藍色、無顆粒，並常見偏向一側的胞質突起或尾巴（pseudopod / tail），這種「灰藍無顆粒胞質＋偽足」提示母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）。
features: Numerous medium-sized blasts with irregular, angulated to indented nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Moderate pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm, often eccentric with pseudopod-like tails or projections
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules in the blasts
Background with residual segmented neutrophils, small dark round nuclei (lymphocytes/orthochromatic normoblasts)
describe_en: The aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen infiltrated by numerous medium-sized blasts. The blasts have irregular to indented nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, and moderate gray-blue agranular cytoplasm frequently forming unipolar pseudopod-like projections. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are absent. Residual neutrophils and erythroid precursors are present. Findings are suggestive of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm; confirmation requires immunophenotyping (CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4, TCL1, CD303) with negative MPO and lineage markers.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles and are NSE/CD14/CD64/lysozyme positive, while BPDCN is CD123/TCF4/TCL1 positive and NSE-negative.

ddx.dx: AML with minimal differentiation / NK-lymphoblastic leukemia
ddx.vs: Agranular blasts are morphologically similar, so flow cytometry is required: BPDCN is CD4+CD56+CD123 bright with CD303, lacking CD34 in most cases and myeloid markers.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm without pseudopods and express TdT with B or T lineage markers, whereas BPDCN has more cytoplasm and a plasmacytoid dendritic cell phenotype.
